# Rocket Languages

> > Rocket Languages is an interactive language learning platform offering comprehensive courses in Japanese, French, Russian, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and American Sign Language with voice recognition technology.

The platform features Rocket Record voice recognition technology for pronunciation practice, structured beginner to advanced courses with 120+ hours of content per level, and mobile apps for iOS and Android. Courses emphasize practical conversation skills, cultural immersion, and real-world language application.

## Key Topics

- Rocket Record (voice recognition technology)
- Rocket Japanese
- Rocket French
- Rocket Russian
- Rocket Italian
- American Sign Language (ASL)
- Audio lessons
- Pronunciation practice
- Beginner language courses
- Cultural immersion
- Travel phrases
- SMART goal setting
- Language learning strategies
- Mobile language apps
- Interactive lessons

## Language Courses

- [Rocket Russian Course](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/russian/rocket-russian-level-1): Rocket Russian Level 1: 120+ hours beginner course with iOS/Android apps
- [Rocket French Course](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/french/rocket-french-level-1): Rocket French Level 1: 120+ hours beginner course with mobile apps
- [Learn American Sign Language with Rocket Sign Language](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/sign-language): Rocket Sign Language: ASL course with video lessons and Deaf culture focus

## Japanese Learning Resources

- [Learn Japanese](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/learn): Hub for Japanese learning tips, study guides, and polyglot techniques
- [Free Japanese Lessons](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/lessons): Free Japanese lessons with Rocket Record voice recognition technology
- [Japanese Greetings](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/salutations/japanese-greetings): Free audio lesson on Japanese greetings beyond konnichiwa with etiquette
- [Japanese Expressions](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/lessons/japanese-expressions): Common Japanese phrases and expressions for socializing with locals
- [Where in Japanese](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/questions/where-in-japanese): Learn to ask 'where' and get directions in Japanese for travel in Japan
- [No in Japanese](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/lessons/no-in-japanese): Learn polite refusal phrases and saying 'no' in Japanese with etiquette
- [Tools in Japanese](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/japanese/vocabulary/tools-in-japanese): Japanese vocabulary for tools and hardware with Rocket Record practice

## Italian Learning Resources

- [How Long Does It Take To Learn Italian](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/italian/learn/how-long-does-it-take-to-learn-italian): Guide on Italian learning duration, fluency factors, and bilingual advantage
- [Italian Questions](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/italian/questions): Italian interrogative pronouns and question-asking skills for Italy

## Russian Learning Resources

- [Days of the Week in Russian](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/russian/time/days-of-the-week-in-russian): Russian vocabulary lesson covering days of the week with pronunciation
- [Shopping in Russian](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/russian/lessons/shopping-in-russian): Beginner lesson on shopping phrases, retail vocabulary, and Russian signs
- [The Best Russian Learning Software: What to Look For](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/russian/learn/the-best-russian-learning-software): Guide to selecting Russian learning software with SMART goal setting tips

## Spanish & Portuguese Lessons

- [Directions in Spanish](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/spanish/lessons/directions-in-spanish): Spanish navigation phrases and asking directions for travel with audio
- [Hobbies in Portuguese](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/portuguese/lessons/hobbies-in-portuguese): Free audio lesson on discussing hobbies and free time in Portuguese

## Language Learning Tips & Blog

- [How to Improve your Vocabulary (6 Fun Ways: Without Flashcards!)](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/blog/6-fun-ways-how-to-improve-your-vocabulary-without-flashcards): 6 fun vocabulary-building methods without flashcards: reading, music, more
- [Language Learning Myths: Adults and Language Learning](https://www.rocketlanguages.com/blog/language-learning-myths-adults-and-language-learning): Debunking adult language learning myths: brain plasticity and acquisition
